mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization (code, name, description, parent_id, depth, path, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{parentId}, #{depth}, #{path}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'ACTIVE'), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE organization SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), parent_id = #{parentId}, depth = #{depth}, path = #{path}, sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), status = COALESCE(#{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE organization SET path = #{newPrefix} || SUBSTRING(path FROM LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1), updated_at = NOW() WHERE path LIKE #{oldPrefix} || '%' AND deleted_at IS NULL
